|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Aurra Sing (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-02-Aurra_Sing-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-02-Aurra_Sing.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-aurrasing-pre.gif]]) show the original text; see [[Aurra Sing (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Aurra Sing (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Aurra Sing (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi” to “relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi”. PC-E1 text: “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="cl-1250_2-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
